{"consolidated_memory":"DROPPED ROWS IN INGEST/PIPELINE/DEDUPE.PY - TWO INCIDENTS (Jan 16-20, 2026)

Component: ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py (ingest side)
Problem: Dropped rows in the dedupe stage - same corner of the codebase
Signal (both incidents): output count below input count

INCIDENT 1: [2026-01-16]
Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Conditions: Only appeared when input list came in empty
Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and added a bounded wait queue
PR: #2171 on branch fix/dropped-rows-1
Reproduction method: run pipeline over overlapping day partitions
Result: Job finished in 6 minutes instead of 9 hours (improvement from 9 hours)

INCIDENT 2: [2026-01-20]
Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
Conditions: Only appeared for records carrying non-ASCII names
Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
PR: #5725 on branch fix/dropped-rows-2
Reproduction method: run pipeline over overlapping day partitions
Result: Reclaimed 82 GB of blob storage

Context: Both incidents occurred in the same corner of the code, with context carried over from earlier dropped rows work."}
